scores.claim_text: Switchblade 300/600 loitering munitions as core precision-strike pillar.
scores.interpretation: Switchblade procurement / LMS production lines are not represented in the 410-PE J-Book corpus (corpus emphasis is DARPA / MDA / SOCOM / Air Force / Space Force RDT&E; Switchblade is funded under Army OPA and SOCOM rapid-acquisition channels not yet seeded). Per heuristic 7, NOT_FOUND -> UNVERIFIABLE; do NOT treat as red flag without coverage extension. Forward-test framework gap: J-Book corpus needs Army Procurement of Ammunition / SOCOM Major Force Program-11 line items to verify AVAV's flagship product.

scores.claim_text: Puma / Raven Small UAS portfolio sold to Army and allied governments.
scores.interpretation: Army SRR Program of Record and legacy Raven RQ-11 / Puma AE recap lines are not in the J-Book corpus. Per heuristic 7, NOT_FOUND is UNVERIFIABLE rather than negative. Note: Army has publicly down-selected Skydio / Anduril Ghost on SRR — but cannot adjudicate that here without coverage. Coverage gap flagged.

scores.claim_text: JUMP 20 / T-20 (Group 3 MUAS) positioned for Army FTUAS Program of Record.
scores.interpretation: FTUAS Increment 2 sits in Army RDT&E BA-4/5 line items not seeded in this corpus. Per heuristic 7, treat as UNVERIFIABLE. The 10-K itself flags that the prior FTUAS down-select missed AVAV (C10), so the forward thesis on JUMP 20 carries elevated narrative-load even if J-Book can't adjudicate.

scores.claim_text: BlueHalo Locust LWS / Locust TATS directed-energy product line.
scores.M_value: Directed Energy Prototyping (PE 0604032F): UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR (FY24 $1.246M, FY25 $1.312M, FY26 $0). Directed Energy Technology (PE 0602605F): FUNDED_STEADY (FY24 $111M -> FY26 $92M).
scores.interpretation: Mixed signal. The Air Force *prototyping* line that funds late-stage DE transitions like Locust-class systems went to zero in FY26 (first unfunded year). The earlier-stage *technology* line is steady but shrinking modestly (~$92M). AVAV does NOT name PE 0604032F directly, so this is not a Mode-A claim verification falsification, but a Mode-B implied-verification derivation: AVAV markets Locust LWS as a forward directed-energy product yet the AF Prototyping PE most likely to fund operational DE prototypes is unfunded in FY26. Materiality is moderated because (a) Army IFPC-HEL and Navy HELIOS sit in separate appropriations not queried here, (b) Locust is a roll-on/roll-off C-UAS DE system whose buyer could be Army or SOCOM rather than AF, (c) revenue split between AVAV legacy AS and BlueHalo SCDE is not disclosed. Scored MODERATE per heuristic 2 (future pipeline + UNFUNDED -> downgrade to MODERATE).

scores.claim_text: PANTHER phased-array antennas supporting Pentagon hypersonics telemetry.
scores.M_value: Hypersonics Prototyping (PE 0604033F): UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS (FY24 $27.9M, FY25 $0, FY26 $0). Companion PE 0604183F (Hypersonics Prototyping - HACM): not yet adjudicated.
scores.interpretation: Mode-B finding. AVAV/BlueHalo names PANTHER as a hypersonic test-support product. The AF Hypersonics Prototyping PE on which broad hypersonic prototyping efforts sit has been zeroed for two consecutive FYs — i.e., the umbrella Air Force RDT&E hypersonics line that would historically purchase telemetry/range support is structurally de-funded. HACM (a specific weapon program, PE 0604183F) and Navy CPS / Army LRHW sit elsewhere, so PANTHER could still sell into Army range testing, MDA test events, etc. Per heuristic 2 (no revenue concentration claim attached) -> MODERATE.

scores.claim_text: Space subsystems positioned for SDA Transport Layer Tranche 3.
scores.M_value: Tranche 3 Transport Layer (PE 1206410SF): UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS. Congress added $500M FY25; Pentagon rejected. Requirements rolled into Space Data Network (SDN) backbone sole-sourced to SpaceX (Starshield). Companion T3 Tracking Layer remains FUNDED_STEADY. SDA T0-T2: FUNDED_SHRINKING.
scores.interpretation: Mode-B finding. AVAV/BlueHalo's space subsystems business is heavily oriented at the SDA Transport Layer bus suppliers (York, Lockheed, Northrop). With T3 Transport unfunded for two FYs and Pentagon redirecting to Starshield sole-source, the forward addressable market for AVAV/BlueHalo's command/data-handling, ADCS and steering-mirror subsystems on SDA Transport buses is impaired. T3 Tracking Layer remains funded, providing partial offset. Per heuristic 1 (UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS -> RED_FLAG); downgraded one tier to SEVERE because (a) AVAV does not name Tranche 3 directly, (b) replacement_sole_source (SpaceX) means subsystem suppliers are likely shut out structurally — not merely delayed.

scores.claim_text: $726.6M funded backlog, ~90% to recognize FY26; $774.6M unfunded backlog (+471% YoY).
scores.M_value: Not executed in this run (usaspending pairing reserved for materiality test). Backlog figures are point-in-time disclosures internal to the 10-K and not falsifiable via J-Book.
scores.interpretation: The $774.6M unfunded-backlog jump deserves attention (it is contract ceiling not appropriations-backed), but the standalone disclosure is consistent with IDIQ ceiling growth from Switchblade and BlueHalo close. Without J-Book corpus coverage of the underlying procurement lines (Army OPA Switchblade, SOCOM rapid-acquisition), no falsification possible. PASS on disclosure quality.

scores.claim_text: FY25 customer concentration: 20% U.S. Army, 27% other USG, 53% foreign (Ukraine = 18%).
scores.M_value: Not executed. Concentration disclosure is intrinsic to the filing.
scores.interpretation: The Ukraine = 18% of total revenue figure is the largest single-customer exposure and a structural risk channel (FMS / USAI authorization-dependent). However it is fully disclosed, so PASS on disclosure quality. Mode-B note: the J-Book corpus does not directly map to FMS / USAI funding, so this is a coverage gap.

scores.claim_text: BlueHalo acquisition added 150 issued U.S. patents.
scores.interpretation: Control claim. No falsification grounds in this cohort scope.

scores.claim_text: Prior MUAS goodwill impairment after losing FTUAS Program-of-Record down-select demonstrates program-loss materiality.
scores.M_value: NOT_FOUND in J-Book corpus (Army RDT&E line not seeded).
scores.interpretation: Self-attesting historical disclosure (impairment already taken). Useful as forward signal: AVAV concedes that DoD program-of-record losses force non-cash writedowns. PASS for honest disclosure of prior loss. The fact that the framework cannot directly verify the FTUAS forward funding trajectory is a corpus-coverage gap, not a finding against AVAV.

key_findings: Heuristic-7 coverage gap: AVAV's flagship Switchblade / Puma / Raven / JUMP 20 / FTUAS / SRR lines are not in the 410-PE J-Book corpus -> UNVERIFIABLE rather than red flag.

Mode-B (implied-verification) findings on the BlueHalo side: AF Directed Energy Prototyping (PE 0604032F) is UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR (FY26 zero), AF Hypersonics Prototyping (PE 0604033F) is UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS, SDA Tranche 3 Transport Layer (PE 1206410SF) is UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS with replacement sole-sourced to SpaceX. AVAV does not name these PEs directly so they don't falsify a specific claim, but they shrink the forward addressable market for BlueHalo's DE / hypersonics-test / space-subsystem product lines.
Companion FUNDED PEs (Directed Energy Technology FUNDED_STEADY; T3 Tracking Layer FUNDED_STEADY) provide partial offset.
Ukraine = 18% of FY25 revenue is the largest single concentration risk; not falsifiable via J-Book.
